opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Grants under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs. For local community capital projects grants are likely to be no greater than £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt or excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or a Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities/councils.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects (building works, repairs, or necessary equipment), or specific projects/activities with defined scope and timescale. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines for submission. Applications reviewed in the order received, with decisions within 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: Grants of £100,000 and over. Total cost of what is being applied for must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs: organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs: total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (organisation income does not need to exceed £1 million). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation under Charity Commission guidance.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over for operating/core costs, capital projects, or specific projects. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest form, which can be submitted all year round with no deadlines. Expressions of Interest are reviewed on a rolling basis; if taken forward, a full proposal is considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year.
